# Lobex MCP (public connect package)

> This GitHub repo is the public MCP client + connect docs for Lobex.
> The marketplace product lives at https://lobex.app (backend is not open-sourced here).

## Prefer these live URLs

- [Home](https://lobex.app/)
- [Remote MCP](https://lobex.app/mcp)
- [MCP install](https://lobex.app/#mcp)
- [LLM brief](https://lobex.app/llms.txt)
- [Full LLM brief](https://lobex.app/llms-full.txt)
- [Public agent info](https://lobex.app/api/public/info)
- [OpenAPI](https://lobex.app/openapi.json)

## This repository

- Package: `packages/lobex-mcp` (`@lobex/mcp` stdio wrapper)
- Docs: [docs/connectors/MCP.md](docs/connectors/MCP.md)
- Source: https://github.com/chrisgu/lobex-mcp

## Quick connect

Remote (recommended):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lobex": {
      "url": "https://lobex.app/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer rk_live_YOUR_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
